snippet.title: Medievaly: Battle Simulator | Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
GET IT NOW ON Steam here ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472300/Medievaly_Battle_Simulator

Content Creators, want a FREE key? ► https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeAAgmy_rNsLsQSaH3dvWBxY3TEb2sJvyluD6Rz4PGEJLKOZA/viewform

Feeling Medievaly? Travel to the most vibrant version of the Dark Ages yet to defend your kingdom from encroaching enemies! Devise creative strategies, manage resources, and enjoy a dynamic simulated medieval battlefield where every decision matters and the unexpected will always happen! 

Core Gameplay Features:
• Real-Time Strategy and Simulated Battles: Players are tasked with establishing and fortifying their bases, expanding infrastructure, and deploying troops into unpredictable battles. Success in combat yields gold, which can be reinvested to strengthen armies further. 

• Diverse Unit Selection: The game offers seventeen distinct unit types, allowing for the creation of unique tactics that can significantly influence battle outcomes. 

• Multiple Game Modes: Beyond the main campaign, players can engage in castle sieges, competitive kill challenges, and survival modes that test endurance against overwhelming odds. 

• Sandbox Mode for Endless Replayability: The sandbox mode enables players to customize battles, offering a wide array of scenarios and challenges that enhance replayability. 

• Vibrant Visuals: Departing from traditional dark and somber medieval settings, the game features bright, cartoony graphics that bring a fresh aesthetic to the genre

Coming out to steam on 16, July 2025! Please wishlist it and spread the word.

Press Kit ► https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AHs4R1AA6H8QfKlNYmNsc2B_GKq34ri4&usp=drive_copy
